summary: Thorough, well-researched analysis with accurate codebase claims. All workflow triggers, integration test counts, Docker configurations, and architectural constraints were independently verified against the source. Four meaningfully different options are presented with clear trade-offs. The two-phase recommendation (Option A for CI gating, Option C for SDLC self-testing) is well-justified and aligns with the trust model. Open questions are specific, actionable, and address genuine ambiguities that require human input.
